findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：公司稱以定價、替代料源與備援產地管理關稅，預期 FY2026 關稅成本對 EPS 中性。
findings.excerpt: In consideration of these mitigating actions, tariff costs are expected to be neutral to EPS in fiscal 2026.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：美、墨、加、中等貿易政策變動與關稅可能推升成本，轉嫁價格能力受競爭與合約限制。
findings.excerpt: our ability to recover cost increases and maintain profitability levels through price adjustments may be limited by competitive pressures, customer acceptance, and contractual limitations.

findings.claim: 2026年2月最高法院裁定後，公司有權取得已付 IEEPA 關稅退款，並於 2026年7月提出申請。
findings.excerpt: the Company is entitled to refunds of tariffs previously paid under the IEEPA on imported products.

findings.claim: Section 232 機器人與工業機械調查：公告認定進口構成國安威脅，目前未課關稅（搜尋摘要，日期未核）。
findings.source: White & Case, Section 232 investigation on robotics and industrial machinery

findings.claim: Q4 FY2026 財報稿：收到 $103M IEEPA 關稅退款與 $5M 利息，並有客戶退款方案。
findings.excerpt: In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company received $103 million of International Emergency Economic Powers Act tariff refunds (IEEPA tariff refunds) and $5 million of related interest, the benefits of which are reported as a reduction of Cost of sales and an increase in Interest income in
